svg.text: Dilated convolutions: each layer looks twice as far
4 layers of width-2 filters already see 16 bp; a few
more layers reach hundreds of bp with few weights
Output: the ChIP-nexus profile, base by base
Two outputs: total counts (how strongly bound) and the
shape (where, to the base). Interpreting the model revealed
soft motif syntax: e.g. Nanog binds best at motifs spaced by ~10.5 bp,
